A '''Star Destroyer''' was in the service of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After graduating from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] [[Vensenor Flight Academy/Legends|Vensenor Flight Academy]], [[Wing Commander/Legends|Wing Commander]] [[Pash Cracken/Legends|Pash Cracken]] and his seventy-two-[[Starship/Legends|ship]]-strong [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE]] [[Fighter wing/Legends|fighter wing]] served aboard the [[Destroyer/Legends|Destroyer]]. When the entire wing defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] took a personal interest in the event and placed a new [[Unidentified Star Destroyer Commander|commander]] in charge of the Destroyer.
